name: Package Registry API
description: Package registry API for Python and the command line: npm, crates.io and Docker Hub search, PyPI package metadata, Hacker News stories and Stack Overflow questions in one client, with one sign-in and the same JSON or CSV rows for every source. Free and open source; runs on your QuanticData account.

commands.name: npm
commands.description: Search the npm registry: name, latest version, description, license, weekly and monthly downloads, dependents, maintainers and links.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Search text: a package name, words, keywords:web-scraping, author:NAME or a scope, e.g. "react state management".

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many packages to deliver at most (1–100). You pay only for delivered packages.

commands.name: pypi
commands.description: Python package metadata from PyPI — version, summary, license, Python support, links.

inputs.name: packages
inputs.description: PyPI package names, e.g. requests, numpy.

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many packages to deliver at most (1–50). You pay only for delivered packages.

commands.name: crates
commands.description: Rust package search from the crates.io registry — downloads, versions, links.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Crate name or keyword.

inputs.name: sort
inputs.description: Result order.

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many crates to deliver at most (1–100). You pay only for delivered crates.

commands.name: docker
commands.help: Docker Hub image search and repository stats
commands.description: Docker image search and repository stats — stars, pulls, official flag.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Image search text, e.g. postgres. Leave it out when you pass --images.

inputs.name: images
inputs.description: Exact image references for detail lookups, e.g. redis or bitnami/postgresql.

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many images to deliver at most (1–100). You pay only for delivered images.

commands.name: hackernews
commands.help: Hacker News stories by search or the front page
commands.description: Hacker News stories for a search query, or the current front page: title, link, points, comment count, author and dates.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: What to search, e.g. "web scraping". Omit it for the current front page.

inputs.name: type
inputs.description: Story type filter (default: story when searching, front_page otherwise).

inputs.name: sort
inputs.description: relevance (default when searching) or date (newest first).

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many stories to deliver at most (1–200). You pay only for delivered stories.

commands.name: stackoverflow
commands.help: Stack Overflow and Stack Exchange questions
commands.description: Questions from Stack Overflow and other Stack Exchange sites, by keyword or tag: score, answers, views, accepted answer, tags, license and, with --include-body, the question text.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Keyword to search in titles and bodies, e.g. "web scraping".

inputs.name: tags
inputs.description: Semicolon-separated tags, e.g. python;asyncio.

inputs.name: site
inputs.description: Stack Exchange site (default stackoverflow).

inputs.name: sort
inputs.description: Sort order. Default: relevance when a query is given, votes for a tag-only listing.

inputs.name: include_body
inputs.description: Also deliver the question body as plain text (same call, larger rows).

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many questions to deliver at most (1–100). You pay only for delivered questions.
